description: Neo4j is a graph database; Neo4j Aura (the managed cloud offering) has a REST Aura API for provisioning/managing database instances, alongside the Bolt driver protocol for queries.
access_notes: Aura has a free tier instance and self-serve API credential creation for the Aura management API.
api_notes: Aura API for instance/project management; actual graph queries go through the Bolt protocol (driver-based, not classic REST) -- tagged OTHER alongside REST to reflect that split.
